faqs.q: Who can apply for Kotak Dream Different Credit Card?
faqs.a: Kotak Dream Different Credit Card can be suitable for consumers who may not have a CIBIL score or income proof required for a regular credit card. Applicants must meet the eligibility criteria specified by Kotak Mahindra Bank.

faqs.q: How much cashback can I earn on Kotak Dream Different Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can earn 2% cashback on eligible UPI spends. Additionally, you can earn 2% cashback on on other spends of Rs. 15,000 or more in a billing cycle.

faqs.q: How does the Rs. 15,000 cashback benefit work?
faqs.a: The card offers 2% cashback when you spend Rs. 15,000 or more in a billing cycle. The benefit is subject to the applicable cashback terms, and cardholders can earn a maximum cashback of Rs. 500 in a billing cycle.

faqs.q: Can I withdraw cash using Kotak Dream Different Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes. The card offers a cash withdrawal limit of up to 90% of the total credit limit. However, cash withdrawals may attract applicable fees and finance charges, so this facility should be used only when necessary.

faqs.q: Is Kotak Dream Different Credit Card suitable for first-time credit card users?
faqs.a: Yes. The card can be a suitable option for first-time credit card users because it does not require a CIBIL score or income proof. Responsible usage and timely bill payments can help users establish their credit history over time.
